changing_linear_scale.meaning: This evaluates the preceding frozen local objective, not a global receiver likelihood; local ascent is not global ascent.

guarantees: Exact expected residual identity for the supplied joint moments.
Exact scalar Gaussian auxiliary-likelihood maximizer with query and approximate posterior held fixed.
Damped local ascent at the same linear reference variance; positive variance maintained.
Gaussian quotient exact for the projected covariance used in the subtraction.
not_proven: A single common prior behind the learned conditional mean, derivative covariance and classifier.
The entire receiver optimizes one global EM/EC objective or has global convergence.
The adapted scalar equals the true conditional error covariance or makes the message Gaussian.
AER is monotone in SNR or improves in an unseen population.
